Name: Jedaiah
Summary: Jedaiah was one of the exiles from Babylon who brought silver and gold to Jerusalem for the crowning of Joshua the high priest (Zechariah 6:10, 6:14).
KeyStory: Jedaiah, with Heldai, Tobijah, and Josiah son of Zephaniah, brought gifts from Babylon for the crown placed on Joshua's head.
RelatedPeople: Heldai; Tobijah; Josiah, Son of Zephaniah; Zerubbabel
LifeLesson: Jedaiah's gift is remembered by name. God records the givers, not just the gift.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
